name: WARNING: Peet's Coffee Iced Matcha Green Tea Latte (High Sugar & Motility Stimulant)
whyItWorks: Concentrated green tea powder rich in caffeine and tannins, sweetened with heavy liquid sugar and served with dairy milk. Matcha's concentrated tannins irritate sensitive ulcers, stimulating rapid bile secretion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip commercial matcha lattes during flares. Choose steamed oat milk or pure herbal chamomile tea.
